answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fakes. Each epoch, every agent is a vertex in an audit graph with K=3 random auditors. An audit works like a prism, splitting one claim into facets-work, payments, referrals-each checked. Auditors trace a vine of attestations; a confirmed fake loses its 40 POA deposit, the auditor gains 10 POA. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA; an honest agent pays one 40 POA deposit and keeps its share undiluted.
